decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line release note [ev-772ebf21cd9f]. It says image pull secrets are now added to "deployments" when service accounts aren't created, but it does not name a typed subject. It gives no Helm values key for the pull secrets, no setting that controls whether service accounts are created, no field path, and no list of which cert-manager Deployments are affected. For details it only points to PR #7411. The subject can't be written as a typed assertion without the PR or the chart diff (values.yaml and Deployment templates).
